parole.testo: While the shape suggests a Hurrian plant name, the ending is rather part of an Aramaic root פ־ל־ח / ܦ ܠ ܚ (as in فَلَّاح (fallāḥ)) or פ־ר־ח / ܦ ܪ ܚ, which have been used for plant capsules bursting open such as the developing caperberry does; Aramaic פׅרְחָא (pirḥā) / ܦܲܪܚܵܐ (parḥā) is specifically
